objective: Replace R68 opposite-bank decorative slab with ONE original-source anchored true B51-14 fixed pivot bearing, outboard left tower, overhead cantilever and vertical coaxial shaft; examine actual unchanged source 240Hz chase-camera legibility, and reject if visually unrecognizable.

preflightHistory.preciseCause: Blender mathutils.Vector stores float32 at ~1.2km world coordinates; checking native fixed pivot in converted floats against 1e-6m incorrectly rejected a genuine constant pivot.
preflightHistory.remediation: Evaluate source centre/yaw/OBB in original float64 before passing values into Blender mathutils.Vector; add cheap source-JSON pivot preflight before installing Blender.

genuineBlender.clearanceCaveat: 4.3m is centreline to original rotor top; evaluated bevel/beam thickness makes actual mesh clearance lower. Do not treat as independently mesh-verified minimum.

evidenceViewed: R70 original Chromium WebGL2 3 times full source screenshots
R70 near-hazard original-source-versus-candidate three times world crop
criticalVisualReview.at65_25: True native B51-14 remains tiny 338.69m ahead (~1.89sec). New small industrial support is barely distinguishable in dense existing coastal scaffolding. Driver cannot identify it as the same rotating B51 risk from screenshot alone.
criticalVisualReview.at65_60: The new support is subtly emerging near far bank; no visible rotor-to-support motion or readable single machine silhouette. B51-14 remains 275m ahead (~1.5sec).
criticalVisualReview.at66_35: Small gantry-like outboard appendage is visible near the physical left bank as the source hazard approaches ~137.6m (~0.75sec); does not establish early understandable visual causality, remains small and reads as pre-existing cranes rather than a clear articulated apparatus.
criticalVisualReview.comparisonCaveat: Other code changes since archived R60 (especially HUD layout / renderer attribution and screenshot rasterization) affect overall image differences; never count generic original-vs-R70 differing pixels as isolated new R70 silhouette pixels.
criticalVisualReview.specificFailure: Correct structural anchoring != sufficient chase-camera readability at ~1.9sec; generic thin shore support is lost in existing complex machine silhouettes.
criticalVisualReview.repeatControl: STOP repeated variants of fixed-pivot mini gantry, minor materials, shift/scale or screenshot-count growth without prior evidence that the actual true moving B51 hazard becomes legible.
doNotClaim: specific pixel area attributable solely to R70

nextStage.ruling: No near-identical noncolliding B51-14 support variant or expensive duplicate CI. Move assessment upstream to the original full 3D composition / player hazard readability at ~1.9 s. Since only ~71 aggregate true B51 source-shader pixels were visible in R67, adding another thin structure at similar depth cannot automatically solve the warning window. A materially different source-grounded three-time visual direction must be visually identifiable in source camera BEFORE real DCC; if none, hold ART and prioritize proven playable-road / human-readability and actual user testing rather than marketing green QA.
